name: Skip Prologue
description: On a brand-new save, skips the "Once upon a time..." stork prologue (game modes $37/$38/$39) and drops straight into the level at map-slot $0B, matching the Flutter hack. Mutually exclusive with "Skip Prologue (to World Map)" - enable only one.
attribution: Based on the Flutter hack's prologue reroute (https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/8972/)
details: The new-game branch (CODE_179932, Bank17) defaults to gm$1F (-> overworld) then, when the per-save prologue-seen flag $1123,x is 0, overrides to gm$37 (prologue) at $17:9953 with the 8 bytes 'LDA #$37 : STA $0118 : STZ $0383'. This patch rewrites those 8 bytes in place to 'LDA #$0B : STA $0118 : STA $021A': a fresh save instead sets gm$0B (fade -> gm$0C level load) and CurrentLevelFromMap=$0B, bypassing gm$37/$38/$39 entirely; the RTS at $17:995B is preserved. Flutter does the identical three writes via a JML to a stub at $92:84D5 - this in-place form needs no stub/freespace. The dropped 'STZ CurrentYoshiColor ($0383)' is non-essential (the already-seen-prologue path skips it too; Yoshi's color is set on level entry in Bank02). To start at a different level, change the LDA operand ($0B) to the desired map-slot. NEEDS in-game verification.
asm: ; --- Flutter: skip the new-game prologue (gm$37/$38/$39); drop into map-slot $0B ---
; The new-game branch (CODE_179932) overrides gm$1F -> gm$37 at $17:9953 when the
; per-save prologue-seen flag ($1123,x) is 0. Rewrite that override in place:
STA.w !RAM_YI_Level_CurrentLevelFromMapLo ; = $0B  (change the LDA operand to pick another level)
; 8 bytes, exactly filling $17:9953..$995A; RTS at $17:995B preserved.
; Drops vanilla's following 'STZ CurrentYoshiColor' (non-essential; set on level entry).
